Subject: Hosted API evaluation — demo request

Hi Marissa,

We signed up for Redwood's hosted API yesterday (thanks for the great onboarding materials). I'm Samir (Product Manager) at BrightLayer — we're evaluating hosted inference for a pilot around customer support summarization and want to better understand latency profiles, pricing at scale, and rollout/rollback options.

Would you or someone on your team be available for a quick 30-minute demo next week? We're flexible but prefer mornings PST. Some proposed slots:
- Tue 12/1 9:30–10:00 PST
- Wed 12/2 11:00–11:30 PST

I'll loop in our eng lead if needed. Thanks — excited to chat.

Best,
Samir Khan
Product Manager, BrightLayer
samir@brightlayer.io

Hi Samir — great to meet you and welcome!

Thanks for signing up. I'd be happy to run a 30-minute walkthrough focused on latency and cost tradeoffs for hosted evals. I can do Tue 12/1 at 9:30am PST or Wed 12/2 at 11:00am PST — feel free to pick below or use my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/marissa-30m

Agenda (30m):
- Quick intro + BrightLayer use case (5m)
- Hosted API capabilities + perf profile (10m)
- Rollout/rollback and cost mgmt tips (10m)
- Next steps / eval resources (5m)

I've CC'd Dev (solutions engineer) in case you'd like a technical deep dive. If you have any sample traffic patterns or token counts, send them over and we'll tailor the demo.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Looking forward to it,
